args.code: (() => { try { const keys = Object.keys(localStorage); const saves = {}; for (const k of keys) { if (k.includes("save") || k.includes("farm") || k.includes("game")) { try { saves[k] = localStorage.getItem(k).slice(0,500); } catch(e) { saves[k] = "error"; } } } return JSON.stringify({keys: keys.filter(k => k.includes("save") || k.includes("farm") || k.includes("game")), saves}); } catch(e) { return JSON.stringify({error: e.message}); } })()
